summary: Check one of several literal suffixes.
documentation: endswith accepts either one suffix or a tuple of suffixes. It compares case-sensitively, optionally within a start/end slice. It returns a Boolean and does not inspect the contents represented by a filename.
inputs: A suffix string or tuple of strings, with optional bounds.
returns: True if an allowed suffix matches, otherwise False.
caution: Matching a filename suffix does not validate file contents or prove that an upload is safe.
scenarios: Offer a local preview for several supported image-name suffixes.
Classify archived export names before opening them.
Recognize allowed endings on internal document references.
title: Suggest an image preview
problem: Input is a filename string. Return True when it ends with the exact lowercase suffix .png or .jpg. Do not accept .jpeg, uppercase suffixes or an allowed suffix followed by other text.
goal: Use str.endswith() or an equivalent approach demonstrating the same premise.
hint: Pass a tuple of the two allowed suffixes.
